requirements.text: Upon loading the webpage, the textarea element identified by the attribute data-testid='choices-textarea' must automatically receive focus, enabling the user to begin typing without additional interaction. The user inputs choices separated by commas into this textarea. As the user types, each choice is dynamically parsed and displayed as individual tags within the container identified by data-testid='tags-container'. When the user presses the 'Enter' key, the textarea is cleared, and a random selection process begins. This process involves highlighting tags in a rapid sequence for a duration of 3 seconds (30 iterations at 100ms intervals), culminating in the final selection of one tag, which remains highlighted. Each tag is created with a unique data-id attribute in the format 'tag-{index}', where index is the tag's position in the sequence. The highlight effect is achieved by toggling the 'highlight' class on the selected tag.

The user must be able to input multiple choices into the textarea with the attribute data-testid 'choices-textarea', separated by commas. Upon input, the system should process the entries, trimming any leading or trailing spaces, and ignoring empty entries. Each valid choice should be displayed as a visual tag within the container identified by data-testid 'tags-container'. Each tag should be a span element with the class 'tag' and a unique 'data-id' attribute in the format 'tag-{index}', where {index} is the position of the tag starting from 1. The system should handle various input scenarios, including normal cases with valid entries, edge cases with extra spaces or single entries, and error cases with only commas or special characters. When the 'Enter' key is pressed, the textarea should be cleared, and a random tag should be highlighted for a brief period, simulating a selection process. The highlighting involves adding and removing the 'highlight' class to the randomly selected tag.

The Random Choice Picker web application should allow users to input multiple choices into a textarea, separated by commas. When the user presses the 'Enter' key, the application must: 1) Clear the textarea with data-testid 'choices-textarea'. 2) Parse the input to create individual tags for each non-empty, trimmed choice, displaying them within the tags container with data-testid 'tags-container'. Each tag should have a unique 'data-id' attribute. 3) If no valid choices are entered (e.g., only commas or empty input), the tags container should remain empty, and no random selection should occur. 4) Initiate a random selection process where tags are highlighted in sequence, simulating a selection process for a duration of 3 seconds (30 iterations at 100ms intervals). 5) Conclude the process by highlighting one randomly selected tag to indicate the final choice. The application should handle edge cases such as single choice input, extra spaces around choices, and ensure no tags are created or highlighted when invalid input is provided.

generated_cases.title: Automatic Focus on Webpage Load
generated_cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage, the textarea with data-testid='choices-textarea' automatically receives focus.

generated_cases.title: Normal Input of Multiple Valid Choices
generated_cases.description: Verify that entering multiple valid comma-separated choices dynamically parses and displays them as individual tags with unique data-id attributes in the tags container.

generated_cases.title: Input Handling with Extra Spaces and Single Entry
generated_cases.description: Verify that extra leading or trailing spaces around choices are trimmed, and single entries or entries with spaces are correctly processed into tags.

generated_cases.title: Invalid Input with Only Commas or Empty Content
generated_cases.description: Verify that when only commas or empty input are provided, the tags container remains empty and no random selection process is initiated upon pressing 'Enter'.

generated_cases.title: Random Selection Process Trigger and Final Highlight
generated_cases.description: Verify that pressing the 'Enter' key clears the textarea, triggers a 3-second random selection highlight sequence (30 iterations at 100ms intervals), and culminates in one final highlighted tag.

generated_cases.title: Initial State to Typing State
generated_cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage, the textarea automatically receives focus and the user can type comma-separated choices.

generated_cases.title: Typing State to Tag Generation State
generated_cases.description: Verify that as the user types, choices are dynamically parsed, trimmed, and displayed as individual tags with unique data-id attributes.

generated_cases.title: Tag Generation State to Random Selection State on Enter Key
generated_cases.description: Verify that pressing the 'Enter' key clears the textarea and initiates the 3-second random selection process highlighting tags sequentially.

generated_cases.title: Random Selection Completion State
generated_cases.description: Verify that after 30 iterations over 3 seconds, the selection process concludes by leaving one final randomly selected tag highlighted.

generated_cases.title: Forbidden Transition: Invalid Input on Enter Key
generated_cases.description: Verify that when no valid choices are entered (e.g., only commas or empty input), pressing 'Enter' leaves the tags container empty and prevents the random selection process from occurring.

generated_cases.title: Normal Workflow - Enter choices and trigger random selection
generated_cases.description: Verify that upon loading, the textarea automatically receives focus. The user types comma-separated choices, which are dynamically displayed as tags with unique data-id attributes. Upon pressing the 'Enter' key, the textarea is cleared, a 3-second highlighting sequence (30 iterations at 100ms) runs, and one final tag remains highlighted.

generated_cases.title: Edge Case Workflow - Handle extra spaces, single entries, and trimming
generated_cases.description: Verify that input with extra spaces and single entries is correctly processed by trimming leading/trailing spaces, ignoring empty entries, rendering valid span elements with class 'tag' and data-id format 'tag-{index}', and successfully executing the random selection upon pressing 'Enter'.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal Workflow - Invalid input with only commas or empty fields
generated_cases.description: Verify that when the user enters only commas, special characters without valid choices, or leaves the textarea empty and presses 'Enter', the tags container remains empty, the textarea is cleared, and no random selection process occurs.

generated_cases.title: Input with Only Commas and Special Characters
generated_cases.description: Test the application behavior when the user enters only commas, whitespace, or special characters into the textarea and presses Enter, ensuring no tags are created, the textarea is cleared, and no random selection occurs.

generated_cases.title: Empty Input Triggering Enter
generated_cases.description: Test pressing the Enter key while the choices-textarea is completely empty to verify that no tags are generated and no random selection animation is initiated.

generated_cases.title: Excessive Whitespace and Malformed Entries
generated_cases.description: Verify that input containing excessive spaces, consecutive commas with missing choices, and trailing commas are correctly trimmed and filtered out, leaving only valid tags.

generated_cases.title: Rapid Consecutive Enter Key Presses
generated_cases.description: Test the application's stability and state handling when the user presses the Enter key multiple times in rapid succession while a random selection process is already active.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Textarea receives focus on page load
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Automatic Focus on Textarea Element
  The page should automatically focus on the textarea element when it loads, allowing the user to start typing immediately.


  Scenario: [Normal] Textarea receives focus on page load
    Given the webpage is loaded
    When the user views the page
    Then the textarea element with data-testid "choices-textarea" should be focused

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User inputs multiple valid choices separated by commas
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Input and Display Multiple Choices as Tags
  The user should be able to input multiple choices into the textarea, separated by commas. The system should process the input and display each choice as a visual tag in the tags container.


  Scenario: [Normal] User inputs multiple valid choices separated by commas
    Given the webpage is loaded with the textarea focused
    When the user enters "apple, banana, cherry" into the textarea with data-testid "choices-textarea"
    Then the tags container with data-testid "tags-container" should display three tags with texts "apple", "banana", and "cherry"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User enters choices and presses 'Enter'
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Random Choice Picker Enter Key Functionality
  The system should clear the textarea and initiate the random selection process when the user presses the 'Enter' key.


Scenario: [Normal] User enters choices and presses 'Enter'
  Given the Random Choice Picker page is loaded
  And the user sees the textarea with data-testid "choices-textarea"
  When the user enters "Choice1, Choice2, Choice3" into the textarea with data-testid "choices-textarea"
  And the user presses the 'Enter' key
  Then the textarea with data-testid "choices-textarea" should be cleared
  And the tags container with data-testid "tags-container" should display tags for "Choice1", "Choice2", and "Choice3"
  And after the random selection process, exactly one tag should remain highlighted to indicate the final choice

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Required to test valid inputs (comma-separated choices), edge cases (extra spaces, single entries), and invalid/abnormal inputs (only commas, empty input).
technique_rationales.state_transition: Required to test the sequence of states from typing choices, pressing Enter, executing the 3-second selection animation (30 iterations at 100ms), to ending at the final selected tag state.
technique_rationales.use_case: Required to test the end-to-end user workflow: loading page with automatic focus, typing choices, pressing Enter, clearing textarea, cycling highlights, and concluding with a final selection.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Required to address plausible failure modes such as attempting to trigger selection with empty input or only special characters and commas.
